ANTI_CONTRARIAN.clause: market independence does not mean fading favorites. Direction comes exclusively from model evidence.
ANTI_CONTRARIAN.enforcement: DIAGNOSTIC, never a refusal. Requiring some minimum agreement with the market would be anchoring with the sign flipped, which the rule forbids.

FALSE_POSITIVE_GUARD.guard: selftest F3 pins that exact case plus line_yards and money_down_conversion
FALSE_POSITIVE_GUARD.history: an earlier crude firewall in this repo matched the substring 'point' and rejected home_ewma_points_for, a PREREGISTERED feature. A false positive that breaks a legitimate model is not a safe failure — it deletes real signal and looks like caution.

FINDING_ON_FIRST_RUN.adjudication: TRUE market data, but a MARKET COMPARISON output rather than a feature: it is computed after the model margin exists and compares the two. Classified into the market layer.
FINDING_ON_FIRST_RUN.the_real_finding: the CFB board has NO structural layer separation. A comparison artifact sits in the same key namespace as features, so the only thing distinguishing them is a hand-maintained list. That is fragile, and it is why REQUIRED_LAYERS is enforced for decision artifacts going forward.
FINDING_ON_FIRST_RUN.what: the gate refused all 8 CFB rows on 'fbs_fcs_extreme_spread_review', the preregistered 14-point extreme-disagreement audit flag.

NON_COMPLIANCE_DISCLOSED.what: market de-vig was used as a PREDICTIVE ensemble component — CFB w=0.3, MLB/WNBA w=0.6, meaning the MLB and WNBA 'forecasts' were majority-market
NON_COMPLIANCE_DISCLOSED.why_it_matters: a majority-market forecast is not a forecast. It is the market's opinion with a model-shaped error bar, and any edge measured against the market by such a thing is measuring the market against itself.

THE_RULE_IS_NOT_NEW.consequence: the 2026-08-28 market-weighted ensemble did not violate a rule adopted afterwards. It violated a constraint already in force. Writing it down changed the enforceability, not the obligation — and that is the more serious reading, so it is the one recorded.
THE_RULE_IS_NOT_NEW.finding: the constraint predates the written artifact. 'Prices are never predictive features and enter only the action/EV overlay' was already asserted in five places in the board builders before this document existed.
